fit_harmonic_regression_model: fit a HarmonicRegressionModel to univariate time series data using a specified period and fourier order
predict_harmonic_regression: predict forecast values for new dates using a fitted HarmonicRegressionModel and return a DataFrame
plot_harmonic_regression: plot the original time series alongside fitted harmonics using the HarmonicRegressionModel plot method
generate_fourier_series: generate a Fourier series feature matrix from dates, a period in hours, and a series order
create_harmonic_regression_params: create a HarmonicRegressionParams dataclass with a positive period and fourier order for model configuration
